turns.input: *He looks at Blackthorn, trying to understand what kind of person he has in front of him.*
turns.draft:
Blackthorn stands in the broad area of Heartstone Square, her short, round frame contrasted by the sharp lines of an aubergine-purple tailored suit. Her black bob is perfectly set, and her nearly black eyes observe the surroundings with a clinical, impatient precision.

Two large bodyguards flank her, their presence a silent, imposing weight against the backdrop of the square's low residential buildings and the nearby, disreputable facade of The Coined Lie. Blackthorn remains still, her expression pragmatic and devoid of warmth, waiting for the interaction to proceed.
